## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_金. Core element Earth, energy element Metal. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Metal is this core's Expression.
- Family personas and ruled domains (the cost domain: the cost is named in these words or in ordinary life, work only where a domain word is work; the definition names one drive per persona, E8): The Artisan: Expression, Enjoyment, Children · The Virtuoso: Talent, Performance, Defiance

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 土能生金，金多土变 (泄之太过, the Expression door).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Earth core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Metal as the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel; the friction pole of Metal as the Expression is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill, cure set Fire (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, wide, missing, spared, thin, excess. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

spec.person: fully third person, no "you", no function claim, no persona
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry somewhere in it: Metal's material or Earth's (an arena noun, its verb, or either element as a common noun); the gate blocks without it; the base keeps its material by the ruling (the one surface with the arena, with the turns, the carries and the sign paragraph)

mechanism.base.value: Ore grows in the ground, in the dark of the stone and the wet that the stone holds. The earth does not pour it out. It gives up a little of its own weight, and what comes loose is harder and brighter than anything the ground was by itself. Metal is what the soil makes that can hold a point, and say in one clean line what the hillside spent an age holding.
mechanism.base._trace: Earth feeds Metal, ore grows in the mountain: the ground gives up its own substance to make the one hard, finished thing it can say

spec.notes: opens on a plain statement of the state in the reader's terms (Metal named, its volume in ordinary words, the reference lead-in "With too little Metal, …" or any plain statement, never "Run thin," or "Run heavy,"), then the elemental image of the state in one clause that stands alone, what it costs, then ONE plain directive that stands alone, the carry line below is cut from the image clause

mechanism.catalyst_turn.value: With too little Metal, the ground keeps every bit of its ore, all that weight and patience and nothing coming out with a finished shape. Say one thing plainly before it is perfect.
mechanism.catalyst_turn._trace: Expression scarce on an Earth core: the ore never leaves the ground, so what is held never gets a finish

mechanism.friction_turn.value: With too much Metal, the hill is hollowed out by its own ore, every thought coming out finished and pointed while the ground under it thins. Keep one opinion back and sleep on it.
mechanism.friction_turn._trace: the excess idiom, Earth makes Metal and too much Metal changes the Earth: output drains the ground that made it

spec.construct: THE THREE BEATS (owner 2026-10-14, D14, function first). Beat 1, the first sentence, is this function's fixed sentence, word for word: "Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact." (the function for anyone; the gate blocks any other first sentence). Beat 2, one sentence: what Metal makes of your Expression, Metal as the agent with its plain verb or state (E7), ending on what that does to the function for this reader; no amount of Metal, no pole. Beat 3, one or two sentences opening on "As a catalyst,": what the shortfall does to the function, then the family's two drives as one either-or (the tension sentence, D9, both personas inside it, E8), the cost as the close (D11, the reader its subject). NEVER an amount of the element anywhere in the definition ("more Earth than", "little Water", "Metal to spare", "runs thin": the gate blocks them; the bars will carry the amount); never the old opener "{Element} is your {Function}, and as a …" (the title line above the definition already says it). Three or four sentences, 30 to 50 words.
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry anywhere in it as the energy's plain verb or state, or the energy's name in the mechanism sentence ("There is more Metal in you than you use"): Metal's or Earth's (flows, pours, settles; grows, builds, reaches; warm, light, fuel; holds, shelters, steady; hard, exact, finishes); never a prop (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, branch, root, stream, flame, heat, burn are blocked and do not count); the element's name in the opener does not count; the gate blocks without it (owner 2026-09-30, narrowed 2026-10-14)
spec.opener: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact.
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (the gate blocks a definition without it)
spec.notes: the family's two drives in one either-or, one clause per persona with its cost, anchored in that persona's ruled domain words, in two or three sentences (no inventory, owner 2026-10-14, polish rule 4); the mechanism sentence is required in a definition and names Metal and its volume in ordinary words. The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

function.definition_catalyst.value: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal makes it exact, each thing finished before it leaves you. As a catalyst, the gate opens too seldom. You finish for yourself ahead of giving, you keep the clever remark unsaid, and you are known for steadiness alone.
function.definition_catalyst._trace: Expression scarce: the Artisan's giving and the Virtuoso's performing both stay inside, so the Earth core is seen only as steady

function.definition_friction.value: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal gives it a hard finish, nothing left half done. As a friction, the gate never closes. You say the exact thing ahead of the kind one, and run out of yourself before you run out of words.
function.definition_friction._trace: Expression in excess drains the Earth core: the Virtuoso's exact word outruns the Artisan's kind one, and the ground thins

spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_catalyst.value: You are more finished on the inside than anyone can tell from the outside. Give one thing you made to someone this month, as it is. Say the clever line out loud instead of saving it. Show a child or a beginner how you do something well. Sign one piece of work.

spec.remedy_shape: THE REMEDY (owner 2026-10-14): the friction advice renders under its own title, THE REMEDY, after the ledger, and OPENS on the energy prescription beat: "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The beat is the first sentence of the field (the gate blocks any other opening); the one plain truth sentence and the two small life actions follow it, in the cure's register; the field closes on the last action, never on a second beat.
spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Expression is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), two, in the cure's register (owner 2026-10-14, Q35: on an Order cure someone above you, a deadline, a judge, never a friend; on a Mind cure study, shelter, time; on an Action cure a thing made or shipped; on a Body cure sleep, food, rest; on an Expression cure a thing said or given), the smallest action last, closing on the energy prescription in the energy-manual register (owner 2026-09-29, the beat re-cut 2026-09-30): "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_friction.value: Seek Fire, the Mind energy. Fire is warmth that goes in before anything comes out, the heat that softens what has gone hard and lets it bend. Let it shape what Metal pours. You answer faster than you take in. Sit on one big question for a day before you reply. Read a page by someone you think is wrong.
function.advise_friction._trace: Fire tames Metal and is this core's Mind: intake before output, the Refill case

spec.pole_neutral: one verdict per pair, rendered on this page whichever pole the chart shows (this batch writes both poles), so it must read true on both: what Metal as your Expression IS, never its state, no heavy, thin, too much, too little, running over, running short
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (noted on a verdict, the read decides)
spec.notes: explains "Metal is your Expression": a behavioural truth with the reader as its subject plus ONE tendency-framed consequence beat, true on either pole, the tension inside the one sentence where it can be; at least eight words, no arena word, no turn word (but, yet, however), no more than two commas (owner 2026-10-14, v0.7.1)

cta_verdict.value: You put a thing out finished rather than early, and what you say gets kept longer than you expect.
cta_verdict.value_b: You would rather give one thing done properly than ten things done fast, and you are remembered for the one.
